overview: Function ke local/global maxima-minima, critical points, monotonicity, roots count.
coreConcept: Critical point: f'(x)=0. f''>0 => local min, f''<0 => local max. Closed interval par global extrema critical points aur endpoints par.
hinglishExplanation: Pehle derivative nikalo aur 0 karo. Second derivative sign se nature. Closed interval me endpoints bhi compare karo. Increasing everywhere <=> f' >= 0 sab jagah.
formalDefinition: Critical point: f'(x)=0. f''>0 => local min, f''<0 => local max. Closed interval par global extrema critical points aur endpoints par.
importantProperties: f'(c)=0 critical point; f''(c)>0 min, <0 max.
Closed interval: compare critical points aur endpoints.
f'=0 aur f''=0 to test inconclusive.
commonPitfalls: f'=0 ko hamesha extremum maan lena.
